review_locator: PMID:36430870, Emerging Roles of Type-I Interferons in Neuroinflammation, Neurological Diseases, and Long-Haul COVID; PMCID:PMC5777301, Microglial Interferon Signaling and White Matter
primary_title: Aberrant ER Stress Induced Neuronal-IFNβ Elicits White Matter Injury Due to Microglial Activation and T-Cell Infiltration after TBI
decision_basis: The reviews identify type-I interferon signaling as a regulator of microglial inflammatory and white-matter responses; the cited primary shows IFN-beta-induced Cxcl9 transcript in primary microglia after TBI-related stimulation.
limitations_preserved: Primary microglial Cxcl9 transcription in a TBI-associated IFN-beta model; preserve the neuronal-IFN-beta source and microglial cell context, distinguish transcript from extracellular CXCL9 and CXCR3 signaling, and do not generalize to astrocytes or terminal-TF output.
